Name: Onceler/Greedler NPC Mod (1.6+) BETA
Author: AKY
TagLine: Adds Dateable and Befriendable Onceler/Greedler with a Branching Story
Description:
The donkey sprite in this mod belongs to this artist magimatica :https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1200
All art assets in this mod were drawn by me apart from this asset as well as edited assets from the original game.
This mod does not have any files from the Lorax NPC mod in it! : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15012
Optional Custom Kissing Mod files: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4664
------
THIS MOD IS 15+!
CONTENT WARNING: This mod has-
Moderate Swearing
Suggestive Themes (Innuendo only)

THIS BETA BUILD WILL HAVE BUGS, TYPOS AND THE LIKE!
 ---        ﻿  ﻿﻿ 
Have you ever felt like Stardew Valley was too environmentally friendly? This might be the Mod for you!

This Mod adds the Onceler to Stardew Valley, you can find him in the Forest next to Leah's house.
There are many fun things to do with the Onceler in this mod, however not all features are included yet. Here are things that have been added:

You can date and Marry both versions of the Onceler!
You can take both versions of the Onceler to the movies!
There are two separate Special Order's you can do for each version of the Onceler to unlock Truffula Trees!
You can wear Thneeds!

And much more to come!﻿


To unlock the Greedler you must go through the Onceler's Heart Events first.
You specifically unlock him after choosing the bad option in his SPOILER5SPOILER Heart event.

WARNING: If you unlock Greedler, Onceler will no longer be in the game anymore, so make sure in advance which one you would like in your game!
There's no going back!

This is a W.I.P mod, there is some missing content for the final release I will list here:
Greedler only has 5/9 of his heart event's finished, Onceler's are all complete. You can still marry Greedler but he has no Heart Events after his 4 Heart.
There is no daily Marriage Dialogue for both of them, or dialogue for Children. They do however say things on all specific dates like Winter 25 (Winter Star) his Birthday (Spring 22) to make up for that. This WILL be added in 1.0.0!
You cannot take either of them to the Resort yet.
Neither of them have a Winter Outfit yet.
Other Townsfolk do not make comments in daily dialogue about him yet.

﻿Hello, and thank you for your interest in this Mod! This is my first Stardew Valley Mod so please if you have any bug reports or any general suggestions for the Mod please don't hesitate to leave a comment, I would love to read it!
